text: The landlord of the Crown Inn
why: The story mentions the landlord at ¶221 and establishes the Crown as the village inn where Holmes and Watson took a room (¶181, ¶195).
¶221 states they are out on the dark road.

text: That night: as they pass out, Holmes tells the landlord they are going on a late visit
why: ¶221 states Holmes explained to the landlord that they were going on a late visit to an acquaintance, and the scene is at night.

text: That night, a moment later: Holmes and Watson are out on the dark road, with one yellow light in front of them
why: ¶221 states they are out on the dark road with one yellow light twinkling in front of them, a moment after leaving the inn.
